A.selection: fixed geographic/boundary-balanced rule; no selection using B/C/D results
A.human_T: reference only; full comparable human elapsed T uncalibrated; exclude A from program-T Pareto/J

S1.source: pre-existing EPSILON_REFERENCES.json A2 angle0; Tref60s is a research normalization scale, not human observation

D.shots_policy: retain existing audited setting; not statistically certified optimal shots

statistics.main_stop_rule: HOLD: formal research/statistical protocol and parallel-condition pilot require separate authorization; this configuration is not main-experiment approval

config.precommit_reason: W levels are 0.75 and 1.0 times pre-existing A2 reference422.45, not tuned to new results; 30/90s span completion-only and old C total scale. Verify on small cases before registering S1 run list.
limitations: finite route pool only; CP-SAT distance objective uses existing 0.1m integer resolution
T budget is measured end-to-end, not equal to solver time limit
S2/S3 not run in this limited study
parallel branches are internal restarts, not independent demand instances or external statistical repetitions
same root seed does not reproduce old serial search; all derived branch seeds retained
no S1/S2/S3 experiment executed by CPU parallel implementation tests
config.completion_incumbent_policy: shared validated greedy/previous feasible incumbent; never replace a better incumbent by a worse CP candidate; no hidden saved external fallback
config.revision_reason: user requires CPU parallelism for B/C/D now and going forward; same four-process internal multi-start for each method, one native solver thread per branch; historical configurations/results preserved

compute_affinity.cpu_ids: resolved at registration from available distinct physical cores
compute_affinity.policy: one branch per core; coordinator shares same four-core allocation

config.validation_IO: one hash-verified common conditions read per Problem.validate, same policy passed to all Snap checks; no constraint value change

dependency_initialization.scope: same library union for all methods before common input read; no circuit or solver execution
dependency_initialization.time: record separately; waiting-process startup is not claimed as quantum speedup
dependency_initialization.worker_mode: four import-only waiting processes before any delivery input read; problem/solver work after shared parent clock start
dependency_initialization.input: complete common input loaded and validated anew in each child inside T

cpu_parallel.selection: independently validated min D then W then branch ID
cpu_parallel.resource_fallback: fail if four allocated cores unavailable; no silent serial fallback

trial_cg.domain: top-dual and rotating-nearest triples, singleton groups
